statement.text:
Let d(G) denote the smallest cardinality of a generating set of the group G.
Suppose that G = ⟨A, B⟩, where A and B are two d-generated finite groups of coprime
orders. Is it true that d(G) ⩽ d + 1?
   See Archive 12.71 and (A. Lucchini, J. Algebra, 245 (2001), 552–561).
   Comment of 2021: the answer is yes if A and B have prime power order (E. Detomi,
A. Lucchini, J. London Math. Soc. (2), 87, no. 3 (2013), 689–706).       A. Lucchini
